root_cause_description: The current Registry set publication exists only beyond the 100000-block verifiable window. The chain serves the same valid registry value since 2026-08-07, but its last on-chain 'set' transaction is at block 86641; the finalized head is now ~215250, so a fresh registry-sync's full-inclusion scan window [finalized-99999, finalized] no longer contains the publication.

fresh_registry_sync_behavior.error: Norn Registry publication was not found in finalized blocks <finalized-100000>..=<finalized>

planned_remediation: same-value freshness renewal republish of the exact current registry value (old_value_digest == new_value_digest), forming a new verifiable publication inside the scan window.
